observations: Photo 0 shows the open interior of a large electrical machine with copper windings, terminals, a blue component, wiring, and visible dirt and debris on the base.
Photo 1 shows the weathered metal enclosure of the machine with a circular side access cover.
Photo 2 shows the end of the machine with the terminal cover removed, revealing rows of stator terminal ports and signs of wear and rust.
A watermark reading "Jueco Generators" with a Lagos-Owodelede location and 2022 date stamp appears in all three photos.
No brand nameplate or model number is legible in any photo.

claims.claim: Excellent working condition without any issues
claims.evidence: Photos show internals but no running or electrical test is shown.
Photo 0 shows dirt and debris inside; photo 2 shows exposed terminals and wear.
The terminal cover is removed in photo 2, but repair history cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Windings may be burnt, damaged, or shorted internally
risks.proof: Video of the alternator running or an insulation resistance/megger test reading

risks.risk: It may be only the alternator head without a coupled engine
risks.proof: Photo showing the full unit and whether an engine is attached
risks.if_unproven: as alternator only, not a complete generator set

risks.risk: Internal debris may indicate water or contaminant damage
risks.proof: Close-up photo of winding condition and evidence the interior is dry
risks.if_unproven: as needing cleaning and possible rewinding

proof_requests: Video of the alternator running under load
Megger or insulation resistance test reading for the windings
Photo showing whether an engine is coupled to the alternator
Close-up photo of any nameplate or rating label
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used alternator/generator head, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working despite unverified condition claims.
